leads.name: The Cedar of Monfalletto, Annunziata di La Morra
leads.reason: Reader's tip 2026-11-15 (submission 702): 'an astonishing Libanon Cedar' on the hill of Monfalletto at Annunziata, La Morra, in the Langhe. Not yet verified: needs a source, a pin and whether it stands on the Monfalletto wine estate open to visitors or only in view from the road.
